statements.subject: message
statements.description: tenant: string, No. Optional. Tenant ID, provided as a path parameter.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: message: Message, Yes. The message to send to the agent.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: configuration: SendMessageConfiguration, No. Configuration for the send request.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: metadata: object, No. A flexible key-value map for passing additional context or parameters.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: acceptedOutputModes: array of string, No. A list of media types the client is prepared to accept for response parts. Agents SHOULD use this to tailor their output.

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: taskPushNotificationConfig: TaskPushNotificationConfig, No. Configuration for the agent to send push notifications for task updates. Task id should be empty when sending this configuration in a SendMessage request.

statements.subject: task
statements.description: historyLength: integer, No. The maximum number of most recent messages from the task's history to retrieve in the response. An unset value means the client does not impose any limit. A value of zero is a request to not include any messages. The server MUST NOT return more messages than the provided value, but MAY apply a lower limit.

statements.subject: task
statements.description: returnImmediately: boolean, No. If true, the operation returns immediately after creating the task, even if processing is still in progress. If false (default), the operation MUST wait until the task reaches a terminal (COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELED, REJECTED) or interrupted (INPUT_REQUIRED, AUTH_REQUIRED) state before returning.

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: task: Task, Optional (OneOf). A Task object containing the current state of the task.

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: message: Message, Optional (OneOf). A Message object containing a message from the agent.

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: statusUpdate: TaskStatusUpdateEvent, Optional (OneOf). An event indicating a task status update.

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: artifactUpdate: TaskArtifactUpdateEvent, Optional (OneOf). An event indicating a task artifact update.

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: A StreamResponse MUST contain exactly one of the following: task, message, statusUpdate, artifactUpdate
statements.guard_semantics: exactly one of {task, message, statusUpdate, artifactUpdate} must be non-null per StreamResponse instance; NuXMV INVAR: (StreamResponse.task != null) + (StreamResponse.message != null) + (StreamResponse.statusUpdate != null) + (StreamResponse.artifactUpdate != null) = 1

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Blocking (return_immediately: false or unset): The operation MUST wait until the task reaches a terminal state (COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELED, REJECTED) or an interrupted state (INPUT_REQUIRED, AUTH_REQUIRED) before returning. The response MUST include the latest task state with all artifacts and status information. This is the default behavior.
statements.post_cond: (task.state = COMPLETED | task.state = FAILED | task.state = CANCELED | task.state = REJECTED | task.state = INPUT_REQUIRED | task.state = AUTH_REQUIRED) & response.latest_task_state_included = true & response.all_artifacts_included = true
actions: Block operation until task reaches a terminal state (COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELED, REJECTED) or interrupted state (INPUT_REQUIRED, AUTH_REQUIRED)
Return response containing latest task state with all artifacts and status information

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Non-Blocking (return_immediately: true): The operation MUST return immediately after creating the task, even if processing is still in progress. The returned task will have an in-progress state (e.g., working, input_required). It is the caller's responsibility to poll for updates using Get Task, subscribe via Subscribe to Task, or receive updates via push notifications.
actions: Return immediately with task in an in-progress state (e.g., working, input_required) without waiting for completion

statements.subject: context
statements.description: A2A-Extensions: Comma-separated list of extension URIs that the client wants to use for the request. Example value: https://example.com/extensions/geolocation/v1,https://standards.org/extensions/citations/v1

statements.subject: context
statements.description: A2A-Version: The A2A protocol version that the client is using. If the version is not supported, the agent returns VersionNotSupportedError. Example value: 0.3
